what: Several full-bleed panels (e.g. a contrasting photo pair) stick to the screen (sticky) and stay one screen at a time. For each next panel the photo stays put on screen and only the panel’s top edge (the window) rises from below to cover the previous one. The fixed text panel above it (name, paragraph) stays as it is, the (01)~(0N) number on one side changes the moment the window has fully risen, and a 1px progress line refills from the start for each panel. The last panel stays stuck until the next section rises and covers it

options.hold: Time spent on each panel (screens), default 1
options.narrow: Narrow screen base width (px) — if given, hold-narrow is used below it
options.hold-narrow: Dwell length on narrow screens (screens) — the original phone is 0 (the next panel rises immediately)
options.cover: Length (in screens) over which the next section covers the last panel and rises, default 1 — at 0 they scroll up together
options.axis: Progress line direction y (vertical, default) · x (horizontal)
options.lead: When the first line starts to fill (screen), default .169
options.tail: When the last line fills up — screens to subtract from 2N, default .56
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panels that cover in turn (one screen height)
options.[data-fx-part=hud]: Text panel pinned over the panel — the first child sticks to the screen
options.[data-fx-part=num]: Number overlaid on each plate, one per plate
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: A progress line stacked one per board (--fx-p 0→1 via scale)

note: The next section needs position: relative·z-index·a background color to cover the last panel (cover). The original values are STUDIO view() progress (cover 10%→100%) measured at 1440×900, converted to screen units. From the second panel on, children get .fx-pp-shift > Wrap it with .fx-pp-stick (unwrap to revert) — the panel’s padding is passed down to the inner panel

from.where: index.html .sg-pair — original #top_scroll_area: img01~03 sticky (2-screen spacing), #content fixed name, number changes 25%→26% · 53%→54%, line scaleY 0→24% · 25→52% · 53→73%
